# b4n1-boost

> The polyglot accelerator. One native core, seven SDKs — Python, Node.js, Ruby, PHP, Java, .NET and Go. JSON 3-5x faster, compression ~21x faster (measured), response cache, bloom filter and circuit breaker in every core SDK. License: BUSL-1.1 (library), EULA (binaries).

## Install

- [PyPI — Python 3.10+](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/B4N1-com/b4n1-boost/master/docs/src/python.md): `pip install b4n1-boost`
- [npm — Node.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/B4N1-com/b4n1-boost/master/docs/src/node.md): `npm install b4n1-boost`
- [NuGet — .NET / C#](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/B4N1-com/b4n1-boost/master/docs/src/csharp.md): `dotnet add package B4N1.Boost`
- [Maven Central — Java / Kotlin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/B4N1-com/b4n1-boost/master/docs/src/java.md): `implementation 'com.b4n1:boost:0.4.3'`
- [RubyGems — Ruby / Rack](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/B4N1-com/b4n1-boost/master/docs/src/ruby.md): `gem install b4n1-boost`
- [Packagist — PHP / Laravel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/B4N1-com/b4n1-boost/master/docs/src/php.md): `composer require b4n1/boost`
- [Go module — Go 1.23+](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/B4N1-com/b4n1-boost/master/docs/src/go.md): `go get github.com/B4N1-com/b4n1-boost/sdks/go`

## Capabilities

- [Capabilities matrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/B4N1-com/b4n1-boost/master/README.md): response cache (LRU + TTL), bloom filter, circuit breaker, gzip/zstd compression, HTML minification, JSON validation, HTTP middleware, zstd decompression, background tasks, brotli, minification (CSS/JS) + HTML→Markdown, JWT validation, JSON engine 3.1-5.0x faster, Django ORM/DRF/SQLAlchemy accelerators. Cache/bloom/circuit breaker contract-tested in Python, Node.js, Java, .NET; Ruby/PHP/Go wrappers on roadmap.

## Performance

- [Performance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/B4N1-com/b4n1-boost/master/docs/src/performance.md): JSON dumps 3.1-5.0x faster than stdlib json; Zstd ~21x faster than gzip level 4; Gzip ~1.0x vs stdlib; Brotli best ratio, ~1.6x slower than gzip; wheel size ~1.4MB native; 1253 tests passing (Rust 346 + Python 907 + SDK contract suite ×7).
